_readme: Copy to ~/.claude/dev-frontend.json (personal) and/or <repo>/.claude/dev-frontend.json (per project). Project values override personal ones. 'lifecyclePlugin' is left out on purpose: the first command that needs it detects installed lifecycle plugins and asks you. Set it to a namespace (e.g. "my-team") or null (standalone) to skip the question. Remove this _readme key.
